lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Town Council's second reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code on Tuesday, July 21 — this is the vote that would write new wildfire landscaping and historic-review standards directly into Telluride's Land Use Code, so it's worth paying attention. The Housing Authority meets the same day to take up a proposed policy on primary residency for dependents of multiple custodial parents, a narrow but real question for families navigating deed-restricted housing. On the social side, Randy Houser plays the Sheridan Friday night as a benefit for the Telluride Foundation's Good Neighbor Fund, and Telluride Theatre opens Shakespeare in the Park with Henry V this weekend.

notable.stake: Second-reading vote on wildfire code changes to Land Use Code.
New policy on primary residency for dependents in multi-custodial households.
